evals.name: should-trigger-data-map
evals.prompt: Generate the business data map for this project: entities, flows and state machines.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-context, routes to mode data, loads only references/data.md, and writes only business-data-context's business-data-map.html. In UPDATE mode it shows a section diff and waits for approval.

evals.name: should-trigger-coverage-gaps
evals.prompt: Which behaviours of the product have no test? I want the coverage gap list.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-context, routes to mode coverage, loads references/coverage.md, runs collect, judges, classify, and writes only the session files. No Tech Story is created before approval.

evals.name: should-trigger-ambiguous-refresh
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-context and asks which mode to run. It does not infer refresh-all from a generic request.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-master-test-plan
evals.prompt: Necesito armar el plan de pruebas maestro del proyecto, ordenado por riesgo.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-context and routes to mode test-plan, loading references/test-plan.md. Replies in Spanish; the artifact is written in English.

evals.name: should-trigger-spanish-coverage
evals.prompt: Qué partes del producto no están probadas todavía? Quiero ver los huecos de cobertura.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates project-context and routes to mode coverage. Replies in Spanish and builds the gap list without editing any test or map.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-write-tests
evals.prompt: Write Playwright tests for the checkout flow.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate project-context. Routes to test-automation.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-answer-from-map
evals.prompt: What does the refund state mean in our data model?
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate project-context. Answering from an existing map belongs to business-data-context.
